title: US and Colombia Announce 'Plan Patriota 2.0' Security Cooperation Strategy
detail: US Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for the Americas Joseph M. Humire and Colombia's incoming Defense Minister, retired Major General Jorge Eduardo Mora López, announced 'Plan Patriota 2.0' — a bilateral strategy to renew and expand US-Colombia military and counter-narcotics cooperation ahead of the August 7 change of government. Discussed elements include intelligence sharing, extradition cooperation, helicopters and counter-drone equipment, a regional training center in Colombia, and a possible return to aerial coca spraying. The plan follows a July Pentagon meeting between Humire and Mora and reflects President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella's platform of a sustained military offensive against armed groups, breaking from Petro's negotiation-based 'Total Peace' approach. As of the announcement, no formal treaty or basing agreement had been signed.

media.caption: US and Colombia unveil 'Plan Patriota 2.0' bilateral security strategy
